findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation for document reads
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows any user tenant to read documents belonging to every other tenant. This removes the sole authorization boundary previously enforced by comparing the two tenant identifiers and can expose tenant-confidential data.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally; the full PR diff shows this replaced `userTenant === documentTenant`. Both parameters are now ignored, so the claimed trusted-admin-only usage is not enforced by this authorization predicate, and no callers or alternate tenant check exist in the repository.
